programme.title: Informatik • Studium • Freie Universität Berlin
programme.degree: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) Informatik, Mono-Bachelor, 6 semesters, winter semester start; local admission restriction (NC)
programme.how_found: Official URLs found by site search on fu-berlin.de (discovery only): Studium -> Studienangebot -> grundständige Studiengänge -> Informatik; department page mi.fu-berlin.de/inf/stud/bachelor/bachelor-mono/.
programme.notes: German-taught. The page's 'English version' switch leads to the English study portal home, not an English twin of this programme page. The row has no official_domain in kb_top100_list.json; fu-berlin.de is Freie Universität Berlin's official site. Applicants with a foreign school certificate first need a VPD from uni-assist, then apply in the FU portal.

value.german_level: DSH 2 for enrolment (or telc C1 Hochschule 'gut', Goethe C2, DSD II C1, Studienkolleg Feststellungsprüfung, TestDaF 4 in all parts)

english.quote: Immatrikulation in andere Studiengänge : DSH 2 Telc C1 - Hochschule mit mindestens "gut" bestanden
english.notes: German-taught programme. Enrolment requires DSH 2 or an equivalent (proof not older than three years); for the application itself a lower minimum German level (C1-level evidence, e.g. TestDaF 4/4/3/3 or DSH 1) is accepted. Not an English requirement.

gpa.notes: Local admission restriction (NC): places allocated by the FU statutes ('Satzung zur Vergabe von Studienplätzen in den Bachelorstudiengängen des Fachbereichs Mathematik und Informatik'); no published minimum grade; whether the subject is restricted is set anew each semester.

deadline.quote: Für das 1. Fachsemester mit Start im WS: 01.06.-15.07.
deadline.notes: Application period for the first semester, winter start: 1 June - 15 July; no separate international round on this page (foreign-certificate applicants need the uni-assist VPD beforehand, up to eight weeks). Printed without a year; for WS 2027/28 it is 15 July 2027.

value.academic_year: not stated (standing policy; semester fees shown for WS 2026/27)
value.population: all students in regular (non-continuing-education) programmes, incl. international

tuition.quote: Die Freie Universität Berlin erhebt – außer für weiterbildende Studienangebote – keine Studiengebühren, sondern nur sogenannte „Semestergebühren und -beiträge“
tuition.notes: No tuition; semester fees and contributions for new enrolment in WS 2026/27 total EUR 376.80 per semester (incl. EUR 226.80 Deutschlandsemesterticket).

value.description: FU Berlin awards no scholarships of its own for undergraduate programmes.

scholarship_exists.quote: Die Freie Universität Berlin selbst vergibt keine Stipendien für grundständige Studiengänge
scholarship_exists.notes: The international financing page refers to the DAAD scholarship database; BAföG only in exceptional cases for foreign students. (The federal Deutschlandstipendium was not checked for FU.)

scholarship_international.quote: Die Freie Universität Berlin selbst vergibt keine Stipendien für grundständige Studiengänge
scholarship_international.notes: No FU undergraduate scholarship, hence no international eligibility question.
